big_case.notes: Petition asking the Court to overrule Libretti v. United States, 516 U.S. 29 (1995), and extend Apprendi/Southern Union jury-factfinding rules to federal criminal forfeiture. While a grant overruling Libretti would have reshaped criminal-forfeiture procedure nationwide and the petition drew a response request plus two notable amicus briefs (Former Federal Judges; WLF/NACDL/Due Process Institute/NAPD), there was no circuit split across eleven circuits, the case arose from a fact-bound nonprecedential summary order following over a dozen prior cert denials on the same question, and the Court denied certiorari cleanly without noted dissent.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction executed on 2026-10-17, thirty days before the 2026-11-16 denial, with 100% result capture across all 11 calls. Tool calls were confined to provisioned case inputs, the prediction-time statpack, and a single general CourtListener opinion search ('Libretti forfeiture Apprendi jury') that returned no results.
